def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers_list = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    customers = set(customers_list)
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    vehicle_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", len(customers_list))

    desc = instance.get("descriptors") or {}
    demand_pressure = desc.get("demand_pressure", 0.9)
    clusteredness = desc.get("clusteredness", 0.5)
    corridor = desc.get("corridor", 0.0)
    trap = desc.get("trap", 0.0)
    structure = desc.get("structure", "")

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    def can_add(load, node):
        return load + demands[node] <= capacity

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for n in route:
            s += demands[n]
        return s

    def best_insertion_cost(route, node):
        # returns (best_pos, delta_cost, new_route)
        # route is list without depot
        if not route:
            return 0, matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][depot], [node]
        best_pos = 0
        best_delta = matrix[route[0]][node] + matrix[node][depot] - matrix[route[0]][depot]
        base0 = matrix[depot][route[0]]
        # insert at beginning affects depot->first
        d0 = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][route[0]] - base0
        best_delta = d0
        best_pos = 0
        # middle positions
        for i in range(0, len(route) - 1):
            a = route[i]
            b = route[i + 1]
            delta = matrix[a][node] + matrix[node][b] - matrix[a][b]
            if delta < best_delta - 1e-12:
                best_delta = delta
                best_pos = i + 1
        # insert at end affects last->depot
        last = route[-1]
        dend = matrix[last][node] + matrix[node][depot] - matrix[last][depot]
        if dend < best_delta - 1e-12:
